messages:
Ana: Heads up — GreenBank is seeing intermittent 503s and large tail latency spikes on dedicated-gb-pool. CS flagged this as an SLA risk for their integration tests tomorrow. Graph: https://monitoring.redwood/g/gb-pool. @Devon @Maria can you triage? 95th->99.9th jumps during bursts.
Devon: Looking. Any recent deploys to that pool?
Ana: No deploys in last 6h. Autoscaler logs show repeated preemptions on node-3 and a lot of task restarts. Snippet: 
```
I0317 14:12:05 autoscaler.go:238] node-3 preempted, restarting 12 tasks
WARN runtime: kv-cache eviction pressure > 0.9
```
Devon: Hm. Could be KV cache pressure + batching. @Satya can you check runtime flags and batching config for gb-pool?
Satya: On it. I can reproduce a smaller spike locally with the load harness using the same seq len distribution. Will open a bug and a patch. Target: initial fix by EOD, canary tomorrow AM unless we can do an emergency canary.
Jordan (CS): From CS: GreenBank wants a mitigation now — they can failover to hosted if we provide a quick DNS toggle, but they'd prefer we fix dedicated. What’s ETA and a short-term workaround?
Maria: I can push a quick runtime toggle to reduce max_batch_size and disable prefix caching as a temporary mitigation. Will create a PR now. If approved, I can drop a canary in ~30m.
Devon: I can review the PR quickly. Also notify oncall.
oncall-bot: Alert acknowledged by @Devon. Pager rotation: Satya is primary.
Satya: I'll monitor the canary and have rollback ready. I'll also run the regression harness and paste logs here.
Maria: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4327 — small config toggle + unit test.
Devon: Reviewing now. If CI is green, I'll approve and merge. Rollout plan: canary to 2 nodes -> monitor 15m -> scale to rest of pool if stable. Jordan, tell GreenBank to expect a ~45-60m window for the mitigation.
Jordan (CS): Telling GreenBank now: "We're rolling a mitigation as a canary in ~30-45m and will update in real time. If needed we'll fail traffic to hosted endpoints."
Ana: Documenting action items: Satya — monitor metrics & regression harness; Devon — review and approve; Maria — PR + canary; Jordan — customer comms. If anything degrades, escalate to eng-platform leads.
Devon: I'll post the rollback playbook before canary starts.
Satya: Canary started at ts=1939000065 — initial 10m window shows no 503s and tail latency back to normal range. Continuing to monitor. Logs: ok, no KV evictions so far.
Jordan (CS): Customer reports reduced error rate and is running integration tests. Positive so far.
Ana: Thanks team. Keep monitoring for 24h; keep this as P1 until we have 24h stability. I'll follow up in morning with a summary for the incident timeline and postmortem owners.
